title: Hitbox
features: The hitbox function in Roblox allows players to easily target and hit other players or objects in the game. This feature can be used in various ways, such as in first-person shooter games where precise aiming is essential for defeating opponents or in obstacle courses where players must jump and navigate through various obstacles.
script:
_G.HeadSize = 20
_G.Disabled = true
game:GetService('RunService').RenderStepped:connect(function()
if _G.Disabled then
for i,v in next, game:GetService('Players'):GetPlayers() do
if v.Name ~= game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.Name then
pcall(function()
v.Character.Head.Size = Vector3.new(_G.HeadSize,_G.HeadSize,_G.HeadSize)
v.Character.Head.Transparency = 1
v.Character.Head.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Red")
v.Character.Head.Material = "Neon"
v.Character.Head.CanCollide = false
v.Character.Head.Massless = true
end)
end
end
end
end)
